title: Product Lifecycle Revenue
scenario: Calculate the cumulative revenue for each product over time. Return 'product_id', 'year', and 'cum_revenue'.
tableSchema: sales (sale_id INT, product_id INT, year INT, quantity INT, price INT)
hint: Use SUM() OVER window function partitioned by product_id.
correctQuery: SELECT product_id, year, SUM(quantity * price) OVER(PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY year) AS cum_revenue FROM sales;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE sales (sale_id INT, product_id INT, year INT, quantity INT, price INT); INSERT INTO sales VALUES (1, 100, 2008, 10, 5000), (2, 100, 2009, 10, 5000);
